entry.title: feat(vocab): 词汇差距闭环 —— 考试词表 + 定级测试 + 重遇机制 + 蒸馏修正
entry.content:
feat(vocab): 词汇差距闭环 —— 考试词表 + 定级测试 + 重遇机制 + 蒸馏修正

设计依据是罗肖尼《如何永远学会一个单词？》的两条操作规则：
① 95–98% 覆盖率的可理解文本 ② 在**变化的语境**中重遇同一生词 ≥12 次。
对照发现项目只做了半条：①方向对但从不测量，②完全没实现。

新增
- tools/import_exam_tags.py：从 ECDICT 导入 tags/frq/bnc/collins/oxford（不重导词典），
  打通四级 3829 / 六级 5295 / 考研 4735 / 雅思 4609 / 托福 6612。
- app/services/placement.py + 前端：Yes/No 词汇量定级测试，20 档等宽抽样 +
  伪词虚报校正，194 题 3–5 分钟。40 个伪词逐个校验过不在 ECDICT 中。
  用 PAVA 保序回归约束掌握率单调不增。实测真实 4000 词 → 估计 4054（误差 1.4%）。
- app/services/encounter.py + lexicon.py：重遇机制，口径是 COUNT(DISTINCT article_id)
  即「跨了多少篇」。文章生成即幂等记录；除目标生词外还记正文里出现的已有学习词。
- tools/crawl_exam_corpus.py：全量四六级真题语料，547 篇 / 301,313 词 / 零失败。

修复
- 生成 prompt 里两套风格源打架：硬编码基准是 205 篇旧数据（复合句 50% vs 实测 65%、
  状语从句 30% vs 17%）→ 换成 273 篇实测值；生效画像来自《傲慢与偏见》且排在基准之前
  → 降级为末尾的 OPTIONAL REGISTER NOTE 并声明基准优先；画像注入「低频词占比约 100%」
  与 i+1 的覆盖率约束直接对立 → 刻意不再输出。
- Article 漏传 target_words，导致 API 返回空列表且重遇拿不到目标词。

方案文档见 docs/VOCAB-GAP-PLAN.md。版本 2.3.2 → 2.4.0（未发布 PyPI）。

entry.title: fix(graph): 重建知识图谱并修正比例与动画
entry.content:
fix(graph): 重建知识图谱并修正比例与动画

用户反馈图谱「比例和动画有问题」，用浏览器实测 + canvas 内省定位到五层根因：

- 多 rAF 循环叠加：循环标志挂在每次都会重建的 graphState 上，切换一次筛选就
  永久多一个物理循环（实测 30fps -> 238fps）。
- 物理极限环：斥力无上限/无 dt 归一化/无速度上限/硬边界裁剪，节点速度峰值
  9651px/帧。只靠阻尼在数学上收不了，改为 alpha 退火冷却 + 子步进。
- 画布比例：wide-view 漏了知识库三页，且宽窄切换发生在渲染之后。
- 内容比例：150 个短语节点连接度全为 0，被斥力推到画布边缘排成硬边。
  rebuild 改为不产生孤立节点并新增「文档->短语」边。
- 数据噪声：phrases 表 198 条 " 实体残留（quot says 频率榜首），同时污染
  文章生成 prompt；词节点混入整句碎片。已清理并在构建时过滤。

另：rebuild 改为全量重算（原为增量累加边权，反复重建会让权重无限膨胀）；
图谱配色改读主题变量；短语改用独立色相；布局改为各向异性映射。

验收：静止后 0.5s 位移 0.000px、贴边节点 0、切换筛选后 0fps（原 238fps）、
画布 608->1018px、无控制台错误；pytest 41 passed、ruff 全绿。

同时移除文档中的活跃 API Key 片段，并忽略构建产物。
版本 2.3.1 -> 2.3.2（未发布到 PyPI）。

entry.title: feat(materials): MinerU as an out-of-process optional backend for PDF
entry.content:
feat(materials): MinerU as an out-of-process optional backend for PDF

MinerU needs Python 3.10-3.13 and 20GB+ of disk, so it cannot live in the
project environment. It gets its own venv and is invoked as a subprocess.

- _parse_pdf tries MinerU, then pypdf, then returns an actionable install
  hint instead of failing silently
- tools/setup_mineru.sh installs it in one command, picking a compatible
  Python and warning if free disk is under 20GB
- pypdf covers the lightweight path
- tools/mineru-env/ is gitignored

entry.title: feat(kb): bookshelf, material import, distillation and knowledge graph
entry.content:
feat(kb): bookshelf, material import, distillation and knowledge graph

- bookshelf searches Project Gutenberg directly (Gutendex proved unreliable),
  downloads to a local library dir, strips the boilerplate, dedupes by
  (source, source_id)
- material import handles pasted text, txt/md and epub with no new
  dependencies; PDF uses MinerU or pypdf when available and otherwise
  returns an actionable install hint
- distillation stores statistics only (sentence length, subordination,
  TTR, frequency bands) and can turn the active profile into a style hint
- knowledge graph with word/phrase/article/material nodes and
  contains/cooccur edges; rebuild is idempotent
- new sidebar section and a canvas force-layout graph with type filter,
  hover tooltip and drag-to-pin
- all styling reuses existing design tokens
- fix: $$ now returns an array (NodeList lacks filter/map)

entry.title: fix(focus): fade the second glow out before the top light peaks
entry.content:
fix(focus): fade the second glow out before the top light peaks

- ::after opacity transition 2.4s -> 1s so it is gone (1.3s) before the
  merged top light reaches its brightest (1.44s); previously it was still
  largely present at the peak and pulled the perceived centre off-axis

entry.title: fix(focus): the ambient glows no longer read as two floating balls
entry.content:
fix(focus): the ambient glows no longer read as two floating balls

- element size 64vw/64vh -> 120vw/120vh with both centres pushed outside the
  viewport, so only a soft arc of light enters the frame instead of a
  complete visible circle
- gradient falloff extended to 78%
- focus keyframes corrected so the merged top light lands dead centre

entry.title: feat(focus): let the merged top glow extinguish within the ripple window
entry.content:
feat(focus): let the merged top glow extinguish within the ripple window

- body.focus-mode::before runs a focusGlow animation instead of a transition,
  since a transition can only reach a single end value and cannot express
  'brighten, then go out'
- gathers to the centre at 38% (brightness 2.6), then falls to brightness(0)
- timing aligned with the ripple (0.3s delay, 3s duration)
- the second glow keeps fading, so the top stays a single merged light
- reduced-motion skips the animation
